target: USWDS modal accessible heading and optional concise description association
observed_behavior: USWDS instructs modal authors to provide a purpose-identifying heading, with specific action labels that explain the outcome. Its accessibility guidance places aria-labelledby on .usa-modal referring to the id of .usa-modal__heading, so assistive technology can announce the heading upon opening. It describes aria-describedby as optional and intended to reference a paragraph or brief description for additional context. The displayed default example associates a concise unsaved-changes message with the heading.
context: W07 B4 K3 bounded first-party USWDS Modal reference; source sections: About the modal component; Usability guidance; Accessibility guidance. Explanatory DESIGN_SYSTEM / OFFICIAL_REFERENCE only; not cross-source or runtime evidence.
limitations: aria-describedby is optional in this USWDS component guidance and is not a requirement to flatten complex or long structured content into one description.
Accurate heading and action text depend on the deploying application's content and cannot be guaranteed by shipping the component.
The precise .usa-modal class and heading naming convention are USWDS-specific implementation advice; this record does not mandate its markup for other component systems.
Neither title announcement nor comprehension was verified with assistive technology or users.
